title: Examples
---

```{r, echo = FALSE}
litedown::vest(css = paste0(
  'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/yihui/litedown/inst/resources/listing.css?v=',
  packageVersion('litedown')
))
```

```{css, echo = FALSE}
.box pre {
  & > code {
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    background: none;
  }
  &:not(:focus) code {
    cursor: pointer;
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 10;
  }
}
pre, pre:hover {
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}
.box a {
  text-decoration: none;
}
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
litedown::pkg_examples()
```
